Message from a parent
---------------------

Our son is 11. He has an autism diagnosis and severe learning difficulties, and he has
never had a clear explanation for any of it.

In 2018 we had genetic testing at the children's hospital — they took blood from him and
from both of us at the same appointment, and the letter afterwards said whole exome
sequencing. The result came back with nothing found. We were told at the time that it
might be worth checking again "in a few years" but nobody has ever contacted us since,
and that was seven years ago now.

He is under a community paediatrician but not under genetics any more — we were
discharged after the result.

Is there any point going back? And if there is, who do I even write to, given we were
discharged? We are in England.
